```{r upload data, include = FALSE}

##First, let's read in the processed data file
costly4_data <- read.csv(here::here("costly_s2_pilot.csv"), header = TRUE)
costly_clean <- costly4_data

```

```{r simple demographics}

#Age and gender
psych::describe(costly_clean$age)
prop.table(xtabs(~Gender, data = costly_clean))
prop.table(xtabs(~race_bin, data = costly_clean))

```

#### Comprehension check: Valuing of Resource
```{r analyze data - evaluation of animal vids and pref Qs, include = TRUE}

#Create new df for analyses
costly_a <- costly_clean

##Liking of video

#Binary liking response  (1 = like, 2 = not like)
prop.table(xtabs(~Q.intro_like, data = costly_a)) #most kids liked video (98%)

#Full liking response (liking binary + "how much"; 1 = a little, 2 = some, 3 = a lot)
costly_a <- costly_a %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(
    Q.intro_like_full = case_when(
      Q.intro_like == "2" ~ 0,
      Q.intro_like == "1" & Q.much_like == "1" ~ 1,
      Q.intro_like == "1" & Q.much_like == "2" ~ 2,
      Q.intro_like == "1" & Q.much_like == "3" ~ 3,
      TRUE ~ as.numeric(Q.intro_like)
      ))

prop.table(xtabs(~Q.intro_like_full, data = costly_a)) #most kids liked video a lot (83%)

##Wanting to watch another video

#Binary wanting response (1 = want to, 2 = don't want to)
prop.table(xtabs(~Q.another, data = costly_a)) #most kids wanted to watch another (95%)

#Full wanting response (wanting binary + "how much"; 1 = a little, 2 = some, 3 = a lot)
costly_a <- costly_a %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(
    Q.another_full = case_when(
      Q.another == "2" ~ 0,
      Q.another == "1" & Q.much_another == "1" ~ 1,
      Q.another == "1" & Q.much_another == "2" ~ 2,
      Q.another == "1" & Q.much_another == "3" ~ 3,
      TRUE ~ as.numeric(Q.another)
      ))

prop.table(xtabs(~Q.another_full, data = costly_a)) #most kids really wanted to watch another (85%)

```

#### Comprehension check: Transgression
```{r analyze data - manipulation comprehension check, include = TRUE}

##Comprehension check of what Stacy did

#Create man_check column to determine if answer is right or wrong (1 = hold, 2 = tear) --> 0 = right, 1 = wrong
costly_a <- costly_a %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(
    man_check = case_when(
      condition == 0 & what_do == 1 ~ 0,
      condition == 1 & what_do == 2 ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ as.numeric(1)
      ))
prop.table(xtabs(~man_check, data = costly_a)) #90% pass mancheck

#Breaking down by condition
prop.table(xtabs(~man_check, data = subset(costly_a, condition == 0))) #95%
prop.table(xtabs(~man_check, data = subset(costly_a, condition == 1))) #85%

#Comprehension of how nice it was

#Recode nice_notnice (currently: 1 = nice, 2 = not nice; now: 0 = nice, 1 = not nice)
costly_a$nice_notnice_re <- ifelse(costly_a$nice_notnice == 1, 0,
                                    ifelse(costly_a$nice_notnice == 2, 1, NA))

xtabs(~nice_notnice_re+condition, data = costly_a)

#Breaking down by condition
prop.table(xtabs(~nice_notnice_re, data = subset(costly_a, condition == 0)))
prop.table(xtabs(~nice_notnice_re, data = subset(costly_a, condition == 1)))

```

#### Comprehension check: Open/lock instructions
```{r analyze data - comprehension check of decision task, include = TRUE}

##Comprehension of open/lock instructions (if we press the open button, will both you and Stacy have to watch an extra hour to watch the videos? yes, or no?)

#First, need to recode these so there is consistency across datasets: OPEN questions 

#in GIRL survey: 3 = yes, 2 = no; recode so that 1 = yes, 2 = no
#in BOY-BOT dataset: 1 = yes, 2 = no (can leave as is)
#in BOY-BBT dataset: 1 = yes, 2 = no (can leave as is)

costly_a <- costly_a %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(
    open_comp = case_when(
      Gender == "F" & open_comp == "3" ~ 1,
      Gender == "F" & open_comp == "2" ~ 2,
      TRUE ~ as.numeric(open_comp)
      ))

#Now, recode for accuracy (currently, 1 (yes) = incorrect, 2 (no) = correct; now, 1 = incorrect, 0 = correct)
costly_a$open_comp_re <- ifelse(costly_a$open_comp == 1, 1,
                                    ifelse(costly_a$open_comp == 2, 0, NA))

#Comprehension of "open" function
prop.table(xtabs(~open_comp_re, data = costly_a)) #majority got it right (93%)

#Now, recode for accuracy (currently, 1 (yes) = correct, 2 (no) = incorrect; now, 0 = correct, 1 = incorrect)
costly_a$lock_comp_re <- ifelse(costly_a$lock_comp == 1, 0,
                                    ifelse(costly_a$lock_comp == 2, 1, NA))

#Comprehension of "lock" function
prop.table(xtabs(~lock_comp_re, data = costly_a)) #most kids got this correct (95%)

```

#### Costly punishment decision: descriptive analyses
```{r describe data - costly punishment decision, include = TRUE}

#Recode punish_decide (currently: 1 = don't punish, 2 = punish; now: 0 = don't punish, 1 = punish)
costly_a$punish_decide_re <- ifelse(costly_a$punish_decide == 1, 0,
                                    ifelse(costly_a$punish_decide == 2, 1, NA))

#Descriptives of punishment
prop.table(xtabs(~punish_decide_re, data = costly_a))

#Descriptives of punishment by condition
prop.table(xtabs(~punish_decide_re, data = subset(costly_a, condition == "0")))
prop.table(xtabs(~punish_decide_re, data = subset(costly_a, condition == "1")))

```

#### Costly punishment decision: inferential analyses
```{r analyze data - costly punishment decision, include = TRUE}

#Test main prediction: that condition predicts punishment
chisq.test(costly_a$punish_decide_re, costly_a$condition, correct=FALSE)

#Check to see if condition*age relates to punishment
model_punish_cond_age <- glm(punish_decide_re ~ condition*age_c, data = costly_a)
summary(model_punish_cond_age)

```

#### Non costly punishment decision
```{r analyze instances of non-costly punishment, include = TRUE}

#Recode get_to_watch (currently, 1 = yes, 2 = no; now, 0 = yes, 1 = no)
costly_a$get_to_watch_re <- ifelse(costly_a$get_to_watch == 1, 0,
                                    ifelse(costly_a$get_to_watch == 2, 1, NA))

xtabs(~get_to_watch_re+condition, data = costly_a)

#Breaking down by condition
prop.table(xtabs(~get_to_watch_re, data = subset(costly_a, condition == 0)))
prop.table(xtabs(~get_to_watch_re, data = subset(costly_a, condition == 1)))

#Test whether condition is related to non-costly punishment
chisq.test(costly_a$get_to_watch_re, costly_a$condition, correct=FALSE) #sig

```

#### Exploratory validation measures: How happy/sad target will feel
```{r analyze data - perception of targets' feelings post-decision, include = TRUE}

##Assessment of how target feels after video bin has been opened or locked (1 = really sad, 2 = sad, 3 = kind of sad, 4 = kind of happy, 5 = really happy, 6 = happy)

#Compute means for feelings when video bin is open
mean(costly_a$feel_open, na.rm = TRUE) #5.71

#Compute means for feelings when video bin is locked
mean(costly_a$feel_locked, na.rm = TRUE) #2.36

#Compare means in locked vs. open scenarios
t.test(x = costly_a$feel_open,
       y = costly_a$feel_locked,
       paired = FALSE,
       na.rm = TRUE) #significantly different (p <.001)

```

#### Exploratory validation measures: What will target do in the future
```{r analyze data - perception of targets' future behavior, include = TRUE}

#Recode next_time (currently: 1 = hold paper, 2 = tear paper up; now: 0 = hold paper, 1 = tear paper up)
costly_a$next_time_re <- ifelse(costly_a$next_time == 1, 0,
                                    ifelse(costly_a$next_time == 2, 1, NA))

#Test for interaction between punishment decision + condition
model_nexttime <- glm(next_time_re ~ condition*punish_decide_re, data = costly_a)
summary(model_nexttime)

#Parse interaction by dividing df
costly_a_0 <- costly_a %>%
  filter(condition == 0)

costly_a_1 <- costly_a %>%
  filter(condition == 1)

model_nexttime_0 <- glm(next_time_re ~ punish_decide_re, data = costly_a_0)
summary(model_nexttime_0)

model_nexttime_1 <- glm(next_time_re ~ punish_decide_re, data = costly_a_1)
summary(model_nexttime_1)

xtabs(~next_time_re + punish_decide_re, data = costly_a_1) #0% of kids who punished, 50% of those who didn't

```

#### Exploratory validation measures: Why did transgressor do what they did
```{r analyze data - explanation for transgression (internal vs. external), include = TRUE}

##Perceptions of what whether transgression was due to bad person or bad day

#Recode person_day (currently: 1 = bad person, 2 = bad day; now: 1 = bad person, 0 = bad day)

#Accidentally run in both conditions; only analyze condition = 0
costly_a_1$person_day_re <- ifelse(costly_a_1$person_day == 1, 1,
                                    ifelse(costly_a_1$person_day == 2, 0, NA))

#Descriptives
prop.table(xtabs(~person_day_re, data = costly_a_1))

#Add in punishment decision
xtabs(~person_day_re+punish_decide_re, data = costly_a_1)

#See if differences are meaningful
chisq.test(costly_a_1$person_day_re, costly_a_1$punish_decide_re, correct=FALSE) #ns

```

#### Exploratory validation measures: Desire to play with target in the future
```{r analyze data - desire to play with target in future, include = FALSE}

##Desire to play with the target in the future (1 = yes, 2 = no)

#Recode play_with (currently: 1 = yes, 2 = no; now: 0 = yes, 1 = no)
costly_a$play_with_re <- ifelse(costly_a$play_with == 1, 0,
                                    ifelse(costly_a$play_with == 2, 1, NA))

costly_a_1$play_with_re <- ifelse(costly_a_1$play_with == 1, 0,
                                     ifelse(costly_a_1$play_with == 2, 1, NA))

#Descriptives
prop.table(xtabs(~play_with_re, data = costly_a)) 
xtabs(~play_with_re+condition, data = costly_a)
xtabs(~play_with_re+punish_decide_re, data = costly_a_1)

#See if differences are meaningful across conditions
chisq.test(costly_a$play_with_re, costly_a$punish_decide_re, correct=FALSE) #ns

#See if differences are meaningful in transgression condition
chisq.test(costly_a_1$play_with_re, costly_a_1$punish_decide_re, correct=FALSE) #ns

```

#### Exploratory validation measures: Target's regret for action
```{r analyze data - targets' feeling regret for action, include = TRUE}

##Perception that target feels bad for what she did (1 = yes, 2 = no)

#Recode feel_bad (currently: 1 = yes, 2 = no; now: 0 = yes, 1 = no)
costly_a$feel_bad_re <- ifelse(costly_a$feel_bad == 1, 0,
                                    ifelse(costly_a$feel_bad == 2, 1, NA))

costly_a_1$feel_bad_re <- ifelse(costly_a_1$feel_bad == 1, 0,
                                    ifelse(costly_a_1$feel_bad == 2, 1, NA))

#Descriptives
prop.table(xtabs(~feel_bad_re, data = costly_a)) #61% = yes, 39% = no
xtabs(~feel_bad_re+condition, data = costly_a) #61% = yes, 39% = no
xtabs(~feel_bad_re+punish_decide_re, data = costly_a_1) #61% = yes, 39% = no

#See if differences are meaningful across conditions
chisq.test(costly_a$feel_bad_re, costly_a$punish_decide, correct=FALSE) #ns

#See if differences are meaningful in transgression condition
chisq.test(costly_a_1$feel_bad_re, costly_a_1$punish_decide, correct=FALSE) #ns

```
